owner: 2026-11-22, x3d arena game b02a58ce (the AI won): "weird it puts valkyrie at the backline, and flying units usually should be in the center to have equal change to catch any side.."
hypothesis: The striker-rush formation moves only isA19DeliveryMelee stacks to the front column and spreads them over the rows in native row order, so a Valkyrie stack (Wind Flow is an amplifiable buff) keeps its native back cell and flyers often take a flank. An entrant whose formation also moves a melee flyer without ranged attack or spell damage (Valkyrie) and gives flying strikers the slots nearest the middle row scores higher against owner-shaped armies than the production formation, without losing more than 8 points on its can-change tasks against shooter armies.

bank.allocator: allocate_v37.py (= allocate_v36 + the seeds19 capsule of confirmation V; SCAN 120,000)
bank.design: one draft root per family; maps 1/3/4 x 3 fight seeds per family; doctrines cycle by family; first 450 families
bank.selection: own = every family, native = families i%4==0; played = every task whose rush can apply with a Valkyrie or a flyer/ground striker mix, plus 30 parity tasks per population that cannot change

arms.settings: HOC_RESEARCH_FIX_SEATS=both HOC_RESEARCH_ENTRANT_SEARCH='{}' life-pool14.sh, spec am-prod-prod, tree prod21c10
arms.entrant: MG:mix:0.5:2 with RUSH_T2=h1 RUSH_T2_MAP=A (league-drafts15: the v27 default draft and Tier-2 rule)
arms.tags: cfP-<population>-control and cfP-<population>-candidate (can-change + parity tasks), cfP-g5 on x3d (30 own candidate tasks)

analysis.unit: paired score difference per task (0 for a task that cannot change), points
analysis.interval: bootstrap over draft-root families (nine tasks each), 20,000 resamples, seed 20261122

gates.P1: owner-shaped strength: lower bound of the 95% interval of the own population's per-task difference above 0
gates.P2: shooter guard: native population, can-change tasks: difference at least -8 points
gates.P3: quality: candidate games with a quality error at most control (same tasks) + 2, both populations
gates.P4: parity: every parity task replays to its control digest
gates.P5: second host: the 30 G5 candidate tasks reproduce the digests on x3d

adoption: a19-flyer-centre-v1 is adopted when P1-P5 pass; a failed gate stays recorded as failed
notClaimed: A win rate against people; formations other than the striker rush are unchanged; the rush eligibility is unchanged.
